title: Exporting a report to PDF
body: Open the report, click Export and choose PDF. The file appears under Downloads within a minute. PDF export is available on the Team and Enterprise plans. The Free plan can only export CSV.

title: Exporting a report to CSV
body: In the report, click Export, then CSV. Files are encoded in UTF-8. Dates in the columns use the workspace time zone, which you can change in Settings, Workspace.

title: Inviting team members
body: The workspace owner opens Settings, Members, Invite. Enter an email address and pick a role: viewer, editor or admin. Invitations are valid for 7 days and can be resent from the same page.

title: Roles and report access
body: Viewers see dashboards but cannot edit them. Editors change reports and dashboards. Admins manage members and API keys. PDF export is allowed for editors and admins.

title: Plans and billing
body: The Free plan includes 3 dashboards and CSV export. Team adds PDF export, up to 20 members and shared filters. Enterprise adds SSO and a dedicated data region. To change your plan, open Settings, Billing. Invoices are sent to the workspace owner.

title: API keys
body: An admin creates a key in Settings, API. The key is shown only once, so store it safely. Send requests with the header Authorization: Bearer <key>. The Team plan allows 60 API requests per minute.

title: Single sign-on (SSO)
body: SSO is available on the Enterprise plan. An admin enables SAML in Settings, Security and uploads the identity provider metadata. Once enabled, password login is turned off for the company domain.

title: Data refresh and automatic updates
body: Data sources refresh automatically every hour. The Refresh button on a dashboard queues an extra refresh, at most once every 10 minutes. While a refresh runs, each card shows the time of the last successful update.
